# Fedora Project Documentation

> Comprehensive documentation for the Fedora Project covering system configuration, package management, and desktop environment customization.

Fedora Project Documentation provides guides and references for installing, configuring, and managing Fedora Linux systems. The site includes quick-start guides, repository setup instructions, and tutorials for common tasks like installing development tools and switching desktop environments.

## Key Topics

- Fedora Linux
- Package Management
- RPM/DNF
- Desktop Environments
- Java Development
- Repository Configuration
- System Administration
- EPEL (Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux)
- RPMFusion
- Quick-Start Guides

## Getting Started

- [Fedora Project Documentation Homepage](https://docs.fedoraproject.org/): Main entry point for Fedora Project documentation with access to all guides and references

## Quick Start Guides

- [Installing Java](https://docs.fedoraproject.org/en-US/quick-docs/installing-java/): Guide for installing Java on Fedora systems
- [Setting Up RPMFusion Repository](https://docs.fedoraproject.org/en-US/quick-docs/rpmfusion-setup/): Quick guide for setting up RPMFusion repository on Fedora
- [Switching Desktop Environments](https://docs.fedoraproject.org/en-US/quick-docs/switching-desktop-environments/): Tutorial on switching between desktop environments in Fedora

## Repository & Package Management

- [Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux (EPEL)](https://docs.fedoraproject.org/en-US/epel/): Documentation for Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux (EPEL)
